DONE / RELEASED — [PR #5747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5747), exact head `f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9`. **No new kappa.**

The requested 31-leaf, five-rank-two connector word cannot have the complete endpoint under its two-port star contract. Paired full queries need total thin rank at least **28**, rather than ten. Arbitrarily fine nonzero stage splits still need at least **20**. The old 127-leaf, ten-rank-one target needs rank at least **88**. PR5681's static maps remain valid; chronology prevents their completion.

The [new theorem](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/PROOF.md) gives `g <= (floor(d/r)+1)b+2`, where b is the extra thin row dimension and r is the minimum nonzero full-query rank.
